item.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers for "mishandling research information"
item.description: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Android Bench 2 Adds Support for Long-Horizon Tasks, Agentic Evaluation, and Continuous Scoring
item.description: Google has released Android Bench 2.0, a major update to its benchmark framework for evaluating AI models and agents on Android development tasks. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Github Migrates Copilot Runtime to Rust with AI-Assisted Rewrite
item.description: GitHub migrated more than 800,000 lines of Copilot runtime code from TypeScript and Node.js to Rust in about 14.5 weeks using AI-assisted development. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Ontology‐Driven Observability: Building the E2E Knowledge Graph at Netflix Scale
item.description: Prasanna Vijayanathan and Renzo Sanchez-Silva share how Netflix tackles observability across 38M events/sec. (1 source: infoq)
